definitions.name: G0C.SUM
definitions.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Sum of a numeric Vector; 0 for an empty one.

definitions.name: G0C.MAXV
definitions.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

definitions.name: G0C.MINV
definitions.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: Smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

definitions.name: G0C.GROUPSUM
definitions.body: GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ G0C.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Keys Vector and values Vector to a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order.

definitions.name: G0C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'LV' BIND LV [ 0 GET ] MAP LV [ 1 GET ] MAP G0C.GROUPSUM
definitions.note: Entries [name amount] to a Record from each name to its total amount.

definitions.name: G0C.MAXKEYS
definitions.body: 'LR' BIND LR VALUES G0C.MAXV 'LM' BIND LR KEYS LR VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET LM EQ ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Record to the Vector of keys whose value is the largest, in order.

definitions.name: G0C.ARGMAXKEY
definitions.body: G0C.MAXKEYS 0 GET
definitions.note: Record to the first key (in order) whose value is the largest.

definitions.name: G0C.ABS
definitions.body: 'LD' BIND LD 0 LD SUB MAX
definitions.note: Absolute value of an exact number.

definitions.name: G0C.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'LS' BIND LS LENGTH 'LN' BIND LS LN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR LN 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0C.SUM 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

definitions.name: G0C.MAD
definitions.body: 'LV' BIND LV G0C.MEDIAN 'LM' BIND LV [ LM SUB G0C.ABS ] MAP G0C.MEDIAN
definitions.note: Median absolute deviation of a numeric Vector.

definitions.name: G0C.MEAN
definitions.body: 'LV' BIND LV G0C.SUM LV LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty numeric Vector.

definitions.name: G0C.SQ
definitions.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX MUL
definitions.note: Square of a number.

definitions.name: G0C.VAR
definitions.body: 'LV' BIND LV G0C.MEAN 'LM' BIND LV [ LM SUB G0C.SQ ] MAP G0C.MEAN
definitions.note: Population variance of a numeric Vector.

definitions.name: G0C.MOD
definitions.body: 'LB' BIND 'LA' BIND LA LA LB DIV FLOOR LB MUL SUB
definitions.note: Remainder a mod b for a stack pair [a b] with a below b.

definitions.name: G0C.DIVIDES
definitions.body: 'LN' BIND 'LD' BIND LN LD DIV FLOOR LN LD DIV EQ
definitions.note: Stack pair [d n] to TRUE when d divides n exactly (d nonzero).

definitions.name: G0C.ISPRIME
definitions.body: 'LK' BIND 1 LK RANGE [ LK G0C.DIVIDES ] FILTER LENGTH 2 EQ
definitions.note: TRUE when the integer k has exactly two divisors in 1..k.

definitions.name: G0C.BIT
definitions.body: 'LN' BIND 'LE' BIND LN 2 LE POW DIV FLOOR 'LX' BIND LX LX 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB
definitions.note: Stack pair [e n] to bit e of n (0 or 1), e being the power of two.

definitions.name: G0C.COLSTEP
definitions.body: 'LE' BIND 'LV' BIND 1 LV 2 DIV LV 3 MUL 1 ADD LV 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL LV EQ SELECT LV 1 EQ SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN block [acc elem] to the next Collatz value; 1 stays 1, the element is ignored.

definitions.name: G0C.ORDERS
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
definitions.note: JSON text to the Vector of its order Records.

definitions.name: G0C.LINE
definitions.body: 'LR' BIND LR 'qty' GET LR 'price' GET MUL
definitions.note: qty times price of one order Record.

definitions.name: G0C.REVENUE
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ G0C.LINE ] MAP G0C.SUM
definitions.note: Total of qty times price over the priced orders, from the JSON text.

definitions.name: G0C.SKUQTY
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'LO' BIND LO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP LO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0C.GROUPSUM
definitions.note: From the JSON text, a Record from each sku to its total qty.

definitions.name: G0C.TAGCOUNTS
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
definitions.note: From the JSON text, a Record from each tag to the number of orders carrying it.

definitions.name: G0C.WORDS
definitions.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Text to the Vector of its non-empty space-separated words.

definitions.name: G0C.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'LC' BIND LC 0 GET UPPER LC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Word to its first letter upper-cased and the rest lower-cased.

definitions.name: G0C.SPJOIN
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of texts joined by single spaces, no leading or trailing space.
